### Why DO NOT SHIP
A reproducible crash on a core action (Export) plus a pricing-display correctness bug in Checkout are both disqualifying on their own; combined with the navigation-state loss on rotation, this build has multiple distinct classes of defects (stability, data correctness, state management) that should be fixed and re-verified before release.'
